jobs_results.title: Backend Software Engineer​/Java - Payroll
jobs_results.description:
Posición: Backend Software Engineer (Java) - Payroll
About Revolut People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, more freedom. And since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. With an arsenal of awesome products that span spending, saving, travel, transfers, investing, exchanging and more, we've helped 40+ million customers get more from their money. And we're not done yet.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ two things are essential to continuing our success: our people and our culture. We've been officially certified as a Great Place to Work in recognition of our outstanding employee experience! So far, we have 8,000+ people working around the world, from our great offices or remotely, on our mission. And we're looking for more. We want brilliant people that love building great products, love redefining success, and love turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About the role

Our... Technology team isn’t just one of the best in the industry, it’s one of the best in the world. And we’re proud of it. It’s our driving force — our engine From building a new financial backend to creating an award-winning app, there’s nothing (and we mean nothing) our tech team can’t do.

Our Technology team isn’t here to fix legacy systems — it’s here to build world-class financial products from the ground up. Products that'll be used by millions of people around the world We’re looking for a Backend Engineer with an entrepreneurial mindset to become a founding engineer building our Payroll product from the ground up.

If you like to work at a steady pace with no surprises, keep scrolling. If you want to work on something 0 to 1 in the B2B space, with the empowerment to shape the product and bring it to life, supported by other world-class operators, you might be just who we’re looking for. Sound like your speed? Let’s chat Our technology stack:

Java 17

GCPKubernetes Docker Postgre SQLRedis Spark Java JOOQ and TDD approach

What you’ll be doing

Shaping the vision and direction for the Payroll product, pushing the boundaries to become a best in-class product within the B2B Revolut ecosystem

Devising and building innovative features from scratch, shipping solutions that are not only functional but also elegant and scalable

Owning dedicated modules within the Payroll product, and leading technical scoping with the frontend and backend team for your modules

Building a high-performance core payroll engine and integrations with other HR softwares

Creating robust data pipelines to power reporting, data science, and analytics

What you'll need Fluency with Java6+ years of experience in back-end development

A bachelor's degree in computer science, maths, physics, or similar field of study

To be a quick learner with an ambitious attitude and results-driven personality

The ability to work well as part of a team in a fast-paced environment

Excellent communication and organisational skills

Fluency in English Nice to have

Experience with Kotlin and Scala Experience building payroll (or broader HR) products

Experience in a start-up or scale-up Experience in a product-focused environment

Compensation range

Vilnius: 4,900 - 7,500 gross monthly
• Lithuania: 4,900 - 7,500 gross monthly
• Other locations:
Compensation will be discussed during the interview process
• Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate's qualifications, skills, and previous experience

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers.

That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Refer to our Data Privacy Statement for Candidates for details on our data handling practices during your application

jobs_results.description:
Remote from Spain – Lead Java Developer to the world's leading professional services company

The client is one of the world's leading professional services companies, transforming clients' business, operating, and technology models for the digital era. This unique industry-based, consultative approach helps clients envision, build and run more innovative and efficient businesses.

About the role and responsibilities:

As a Java Lead you would be in charge of development of new features and new components. You will ensure these are built with the best practices in mind and coordinate with the rest of the team working on other layers of the same infrastructure.

Excellent communication skills will be required to coordinate work accords multiple teams to resolve issues. You will bring your experience, creativity and innovation to the table to deliver class leading solutions. You will work in a challenging agile environment with many other like-minded passionate and creative individuals... in and across the teams in the project.

Requirements:
• At least 11 years in roles as Java Developer.
• Experience with microservices.
• Experience in spring framework.
• Experience leading teams
• Architecture skills
• Experience with SpringBoot (atleastV2)
• Testing experience
• Experience with software design and development in a test-driven environment.
• Experience with databases and ORM frameworks (Hibernate)
• Experience with offline storage, threading, and performance tuning
• Knowledge of CI/CD would be very well-considered
• Knowledge of RESTful APIs
• Create technical documentation for reference and reporting
• Experienced user of public cloud as AWS or Azure is preferred
• Demonstrated ability to learn quickly and work independently and as a team in a fast-paced environment
• Solid troubleshooting and debugging skills: analyze and investigate test failures, errors, and build issues
• Solid experience with Software Version Control systems like Git
• Are not afraid of expressing yourself in English. We aren't expecting you to have the Queen's accent, but you'll be part of an international team and we communicate in English, so you should be comfortable with that
• Fluent Spanish Language
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or Information System, Telecom or 3+ years equivalent experience in an engineering role

Salary: up to 75.000 EUR / Gross

Benefits:
• Yearly Bonus
• Training and career development opportunities: Career path locally and internationally. Specific training in both technical and soft skills
• Ticket restaurant (9€ work day)
• Private healthcare and additional life insurance. (Cigna Premium)
• Gympass
• Company sponsored activities and partnerships
• Employee referral program in place
• Employee volunteering programs and opportunities
• Access to different internal events, communities, and initiatives

IT Jobs Worldwide

IT Jobs Worldwide is a professional recruitment company that focuses on connecting IT talents with the most exciting vacancies worldwide. We specialize in specific IT areas including Java, PHP, .NET, Python, JavaScript, Swift, Objective-C, Kotlin, Dart, QA and Testing, Data and BI, and Infrastructure.

IT Jobs Worldwide is part of the Worldwiders brands, with more than 60 colleagues all over Europe. We have offices in Oslo, Tallinn, Malaga, Malta, and Lisbon. With over 300 clients in over 30 countries, our recruitment solutions are tailormade and set up to add value that benefits the matchmaking process

If you are looking for a new challenge and would like to take part of international projects within a multinational IT firm, this is your opportunity! At NTT DATA we are currently looking for a Lead backend Engineer to join our Industry team.

¿Why NTT DATA?

Because we have obtained in Spain, for the 9th consecutive year, the Top Employer certification, which recognizes us as one of the best companies to work, thanks to our commitment to our people. Join a team that is committed to the comprehensive development of its professionals, choose the work model that best suits you, and collaborate in a diverse environment, where each person has their own uniqueness. If you want to know more about us visit https://es.nttdata.com/

#TheDigitalLovers #TopEmployer

Your responsabilities
• Application development of both backend features
• knowledge of the SQL language and experience in data modeling
• development
• Develop technical specifications from functional requirements
• Bridge between... Frontend and Backend team gap looking for smooth integration of functionality
• Quality assurance including unit testing and integration testing.
• Lead/supervise a project at a technological level.
• Be a reference and add value from technological knowledge to the team.
• Propose innovative/differential solutions.

¿Fit with you?

This is what we are looking for:
• Tech experience with: Java, Spring and Sping Boots
• Experience developing RESTful/SOAP .
• Knowledge reading, writing and manipulating data files JSON, XML, XSD, XSL-T, Schematron...
• Experience with agile Scrum methodology
• Spanish and English level B2 or higher (written and spoken). Able to attend and participate in daily

Benefits for being part of NTT DATA

💼👩💻 Long term contract with our flexible compensation program (ticket restaurant, nursery or transport card), AyudaFlex extra in your salary to cover remote working expenses and Health insurance (you could include your family).

🚀 Individualized continuous growth plan aligned with your interests

👩🎓👨🎓 Training plan adjusted to both your needs and those of the current market. From our Corporate University you can carry out Certifications, language courses and much more.

🤗 Work in a good team environment where you can learn from others and they from you.

⏱👩💻 Flexible work model with flexible time table and intensive journey on Friday and summer time (from 01-07 to 15-09)

🏡 Remote working, making it easier to fit your hobbies and other activities into your day to day and work from home allowance (chair, keyboard, mouse, screen...)

🏢🖥 When in the office: beautifull and modern building in the center of Barcelona coffee, tea and have a lunch in our canteen with 360º view to Barcelona.

At NTT DATA, we believe everyone is unique and different, this is why we bet for an inclusive culture that recognizes and values diversity. We work day after day to create an environment in wich we can explore, live and enhance our own singularity.

#WeAreAllUnique #YouMakeUsUnique

Do you want to join us? We are hoping to meet you
